prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.guideDesc: Short habits that give better pictures.

g1.title: Say what is in it
g1.body: Start with the subject, then where it is and what it is doing.

g2.title: Name the style
g2.body: Oil painting, photograph, flat illustration, 3D render: the style changes everything.

g3.title: Add light and mood
g3.body: Soft morning light, neon at night, overcast: light sets the feel.

g4.title: Keep it to one idea
g4.body: A short, clear prompt beats a long list. Add detail one step at a time.

g5.title: Use Avoid for what you do not want
g5.body: Under Advanced, a negative prompt lists things to leave out.
